contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (3190.00) on the p4 Summary Page, which equals Schedule A's own printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report) $ 3190.00' and its hand-corrected 'Subtotal for this page $ 3190.00'
contributions.detail: 2 Schedule A rows sum, MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND, to 3000.00 + 190.00 = 3,190.00 exactly = the printed Total Contributions Received = the promoted PER-PERIOD Box B = Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' 3190.00 with Box A 0.00. MONETARY-ONLY FAILS by 190.00 (it gives 3,000.00 against a stated 3,190.00), so this filing's convention is monetary-plus-in-kind on the contribution side — tested, not inherited. THE LOAN IS A CONTRIBUTION ROW HERE, decided by the ladder and not by the word (ADDENDUM B3): Box A is 0.00, so there is no beginning-balance slot for the 3,000.00 'Loan to Campaign by Renee Tribe', and Box B closes only WITH it. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 3190.00 (first report of the cycle, so period = YTD) and is cumulative — never summed as an increment. The 'Subtotal for this page' cell is a heavily OVERWRITTEN hand correction; its final reading 3190.00 is settled by the clean Total line, by Box B and by the rows' own sum, all three agreeing.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (1746.46) on the p4 Summary Page, which equals Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 1746.46' and 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report) $ 1746.46'

(Running: 192.33 -> 286.70 -> 296.70 -> 322.31 -> 412.27 -> 506.68 -> 592.08 -> 831.12 -> 1,021.12 -> 1,746.46.) MONETARY-ONLY FAILS by 190.00, because the same in-kind gift is entered a SECOND time here as an offsetting expenditure ('In Kind - Leonard Lee / Campaign Signs / 190.00', same 3/28/22 date and same amount as the Schedule A row) — the ADDENDUM G1 / K4 pattern of in-kind entered TWICE, once per side, with both stated totals including it. Box E YTD prints 1746.46 and is cumulative, never summed. The filer's own ladder closes too: F 3190.00 - D 1746.46 = 1443.54 = the printed Balance at Close.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-plus-in-kind, ON BOTH SIDES — tested per filing, not inherited. The single in-kind gift (Leonard Lee, campaign signs, 190.00, 3/28/22) is entered ONCE ON EACH SCHEDULE and BOTH stated totals include it: contributions close at 3190.00 only with it (monetary-only 3000.00 is 190.00 short) and expenditures close at 1746.46 only with it (monetary-only 1556.46 is 190.00 short). The filer marks it in the NAME cell and again beside the amount, writing 'In Kind' in quotation marks on Schedule A and 'In Kind - Leonard Lee' as the vendor on Schedule B; the v. 4.20 blank has NO in-kind checkbox column, so the filer's own written marking is the only in-kind signal on the page.
